title: HTTP check
description: Reachability, latency, status code and certificate expiry of HTTP endpoints the host's veto allows (module_targets, by default loopback only).

urls.title: URLs
urls.description: http:// or https:// URLs, without user and password.

expect_status.title: Expected status codes
expect_status.description: Status codes that count as up; empty: 200 to 399.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Per request with its redirects, at most 25s.

follow_redirects.title: Follow redirects
follow_redirects.description: At most three, only to targets the veto allows, never from https to http.

tls_verify.title: Verify TLS certificates
tls_verify.description: Off only for self-signed certificates you can't give as a CA file.

ca_file.title: CA file
ca_file.description: PEM file below module_file_prefixes to verify with instead of the system's CAs.
